summary: ADR-0060 accepted 2026-08-18; v1 Skill-input remains historical compatibility and must not auto-promote to v2 authority; v2 assigns each candidate exactly one role: normative_source, authority_source, implementation_input, lifecycle_projection, derived_context, execution_evidence, report, ephemeral_attempt; only first three authorize; separate sourceSelectionHash and sourceContentHash; selection binds roles, repo-relative paths, modules, scope, resources, while content binds selected bytes; adapter owns transport, page ranges, continuation, coverage, truncation and may avoid lossy summary when coverage is proven complete; ready receipts are immutable generations under skill-input-generations/<binding-hash>/; validated non-authorizing current pointer advances atomically; consumers use pointer only, never mtimes, suffixes, scans; independent execution/publication/semantic-review gates; Knowledge self-change derived from changed set and canonical path policy, not caller flag; attempts require leases/heartbeats; retention protects current pointer, lifecycle/authorization/terminal refs, active unexpired attempts; committed evidence deletion requires maintainer approval plus non-authorizing cleanup receipt; workflow repair must migrate consumers to v2 before 8-18 creates a current receipt; existing skill-input-current* dirs remain immutable historical evidence pending approved retention; ADR does not create lifecycle authority, publish Knowledge, or start Bootstrap; extends ADR-0048/0050/0057/0058/0059 and supersedes only v1 selection/current-resolution practices
